title: Marlowe & Finch Unlimited Plan Days on Return-By Extensions
content:
A Marlowe & Finch Unlimited plan adds plan days to a courtesy extension of a Returns & Exchanges return-by date.

| Customer's Marlowe & Finch Unlimited membership | Plan days added |
|---|---|
| A plan that covers return labels, in status trial or active | 7 days |
| Any other plan, in status trial or active | 3 days |
| No plan, or a plan in any other status | None |

- Whether the plan covers return labels is a feature of the plan held; the status is that of the customer's Unlimited membership.
- Example (hypothetical): a customer on a trial of a plan that covers return labels has 7 days added; the same customer after the plan has lapsed out of trial and active status has none added.
